name_zh: 印加/阿塔瓦尔帕/安第斯帝国：安第斯互惠与垂直群岛
name_en: Inca/Atahualpa/Andean Empire: Andean Reciprocity & Vertical Archipelago
description_zh: 印加帝国 (1438-1533) 阿塔瓦尔帕 (1502-1533) 末代皇帝，构建安第斯历史上最大帝国。核心治理技术：垂直群岛 — 在不同海拔生态带(海岸/山谷/高原/普纳)建立飞地殖民点，通过艾尼(互惠劳动)/明卡(社区共工)/米塔(轮班劳役)实现跨生态带资源互补；基普(结绳记事)编码人口/税收/军事/历法；查帕克纳纳(印加大道)连接帝国四方。体现 M165 安第斯互惠/印加 — 以"垂直群岛+艾尼互惠+明卡共工+基普编码"四位一体，在极端垂直地理中构建超大规模帝国治理。
description_en: Inca Empire (1438-1533) Atahualpa (1502-1533) last emperor, built largest empire in Andean history. Core governance tech: vertical archipelago — establishing exclave colonies across different altitudinal ecological zones (coast/valley/altiplano/puna), achieving cross-ecological resource complementarity via ayni (reciprocal labor)/minka (community work)/mita (rotational labor draft); khipu (knotted cords) encoding population/tax/military/calendar; Qhapaq Ñan (Inca Road) connecting imperial four quarters. Exemplifies M165 Andean Reciprocity/Inca — quaternity of 'vertical archipelago + ayni reciprocity + minka communal labor + khipu encoding' building mega-empire governance in extreme vertical geography.
reason_zh: 印加帝国非单纯征服国家，而是"垂直群岛+互惠经济+结绳编码"三位一体生态帝国。在无文字/无轮子/无铁器条件下，以生态适应性实现百万平方公里/千万人口整合。M165 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(核心)、M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 民族建国(伊拉克)，核心在于"垂直生态位互补+互惠劳动制+结绳信息系统"的安第斯帝国范式。
reason_en: Inca Empire not mere conquest state but 'vertical archipelago + reciprocal economy + khipu encoding' trinity ecological empire. Without writing/wheel/iron, achieved million-km²/10M+ population integration via ecological adaptivity. M165 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (core), M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Nation-Building (Iraq), core: 'vertical ecological niche complementarity + reciprocal labor system + khipu information system' Andean imperial paradigm.
steps_zh: 垂直群岛生态布局：海岸棉花/海产→山谷玉米/可可→高原藜麦/马铃薯→普纳羊驼/盐，跨带互补零贸易成本
艾尼互惠劳动制：家庭/社区/国家三级互惠，劳动即税收/福利/防御，零货币零市场
明卡社区共工与米塔国家劳役：基建/农业/军事三大领域，劳役即公民权/分配权/荣誉制
基普结绳信息系统：彩色/结位/间距编码人口/税收/军事/历法/法律，专业结绳师阶层垄断解码
印加大道与驿站网络：4万公里/查斯基接力跑者/塔姆博驿站/军事/行政/贸易三网合一，帝国神经中枢
steps_en: Vertical archipelago ecological layout: coast cotton/seafood -> valley maize/cocoa -> altiplano quinoa/potato -> puna llama/salt, cross-zone complementarity zero trade cost
Ayni reciprocal labor system: household/community/state three-tier reciprocity, labor as tax/welfare/defense, zero currency zero market
Minka community work & mita state labor draft: infrastructure/agriculture/military three domains, labor draft as citizenship/distribution right/honor system
Khipu knotted-cord information system: color/knot/spacing encoding population/tax/military/calendar/law, professional khipukamayuq caste monopolizes decoding
Inca road & tambos network: 40k km/chasqui relay runners/tambo waystations/military-admin-trade three networks unified, imperial nervous system
expected_zh: 以"垂直群岛+艾尼互惠+明卡共工+基普编码"四位一体，在极端垂直地理/无文字/无轮子/无铁器条件下构建百万平方公里/千万人口安第斯帝国，为极端地理帝国治理提供唯一范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'vertical archipelago + ayni reciprocity + minka communal labor + khipu encoding' builds million-km²/10M+ population Andean Empire under extreme vertical geography/no writing/no wheel/no iron, providing sole paradigm for extreme geography imperial governance.
case_zh: 1438 帕查库特克建帝/1493 瓦伊纳·卡帕克扩张/1532 阿塔瓦尔帕继位/1533 派萨罗俘虏阿塔瓦尔帕/1572 图帕克·阿马鲁末代皇帝处决/基普幸存 600+ 件/印加大道成世界遗产，垂直帝国在征服中崩塌但生态智慧永存。
case_en: 1438 Pachacuti founds empire/1493 Huayna Capac expands/1532 Atahualpa succeeds/1533 Pizarro captures Atahualpa/1572 Tupac Amaru last emperor executed/600+ khipus survive/Inca Road UNESCO/vertical empire collapses in conquest but ecological wisdom endures.
